title: TRUNK-6643: Initial setup with MariaDB Driver does not work
body:
<!--- Add a pull request title above in this format -->
<!--- real example: 'TRUNK-5111: Replace use of deprecated isVoided' -->
<!--- 'TRUNK-JiraIssueNumber: JiraIssueTitle' -->
## Description of what I changed
<!--- Describe your changes in detail -->
<!--- It can simply be your commit message, which you must have -->



I  Modified the database creation, user creation, user deletion, and privilege granting blocks to include supportfor MariaDB. Previously, these blocks only checked for MySQL, causing them to be skipped when a jdbc:mariadb URL was provided and increased the visibility of the isCurrentDatabase method from private to protected to enable unit testing. In my changes I also ensured that the logic which enforces the use of the InnoDB storage engine also applies to jdbc:mariadb URLs maintaining consistency with MySQL.
